prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: newly drawn transparent 2D Bone Dragon animation sprites, PILOT ONLY.
Create exactly THREE separate complete Bone Dragon figures in one strict equal 3-column by 1-row grid. Each occupied cell is one entire figure. Use a wide landscape canvas. Invisible cell boundaries only, no printed grid. Keep generous transparent margins all around every figure and wide fully transparent vertical gutters. Every wing finger, claw, tooth, horn, hanging leg, tail tip and any detached source piece must stay inside its own assigned cell. No fragment may drift into a neighboring cell. Nothing cropped or touching the image edges.

Input image 1 is the labeled CNDRGN original source POSE guide. Its three cells in exact left-to-right order are bone_dragon_p000 (OG group 0 frame 0), bone_dragon_p002 (OG group 0 frame 2), bone_dragon_p042 (OG group 11 frame 5). Copy the particular silhouette, action, original view, skull angle, wing articulation, leg bends, tail shape and visible anatomy of EACH corresponding cell. The source pixels are pose references only; redraw at high resolution, never enlarge pixel art.
Input image 2 is the APPROVED appearance master only: use its warm aged ivory skeleton, dry dark charcoal/slate membranes, convincing modeled bone volumes, worn bone fissures, shadowed empty eye sockets, pointed dragon skull, teeth and curved bone claws. This master does not control pose. Do not copy its upright idle pose into these flight and attack drawings.

LEFT CELL / bone_dragon_p000: fully airborne original right-facing side/three-quarter dragon. Elongated nearly horizontal spine and ribcage, skull stretched to the right with open toothy jaw. Long sinuous tapering bony tail extends far to the left in the original wavy S curve. Both wings make a high upstroke: long wing bones and dark ragged membranes rise diagonally up-left well above the body, making the tall flight silhouette of guide cell 1. Two bent hind legs hang below the left half of the torso; two clawed forelimbs hang forward/below the chest at right. Preserve the open negative spaces between each hanging limb and ribs. Follow the original, not a standing dragon.

MIDDLE CELL / bone_dragon_p002: the different original airborne right-facing flight phase, much lower and wider silhouette. Long skeletal torso nearly horizontal, tail curling left, skull at upper-right facing right. Wings sweep backward to the left at a LOW shallow diagonal above the back, rather than standing vertically; match the overlapping wing fingers in guide cell 2. Bent legs hang below, with separate rear feet under the belly and front claw hands reaching right/down. Keep the total height-to-width ratio from this original pose. This is not a duplicate of the left high-upstroke drawing.

RIGHT CELL / bone_dragon_p042: original grounded attack/recovery extreme. More upright diagonal ribcage and curved neck, skull angled slightly DOWN and right as in guide cell 3. Large folded/arched wing rises behind the torso toward upper-left then droops down-left, with distinct long bony spars and torn dark membrane. Foreclaws curl forward/down in front of the right side of the ribs. Long skeletal hind legs are bent and splayed, their toes reaching low and to the right; bony tail curls down-left near the lowest foot, exactly as in the source. Preserve the low extremities and the original compact width and tall wing silhouette; do not replace this with the approved master pose.

Style: faithful to the approved master, finely modeled 2D fantasy sprite illustration, crisp silhouette, warm ivory bone highlights, aged ochre crevices, dark dry torn membranes, solid readable ribcage and skeletal joints. Detailed but restrained material shading, readable at game size, consistent identity and anatomy across all three drawings. Keep source proportions, projected perspective and pose differences; draw all three at a consistent natural anatomical scale while retaining their different occupied extents. No arbitrary extra horns, flesh, armor, weapons, glowing eyes, green magic, smoke or added effects.

Background: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT ALPHA everywhere outside the figures and through anatomical holes and membrane tears. NO floor, cast shadow, contact shadow, dark vignette, checkerboard painted into the artwork, background color, labels, letters, numbers, caption, frame, ruler, watermark or grid lines. The final PNG contains only the three isolated newly drawn figures in their exact source order.
